events.title: Parking Lot Brawl!
events.description: Two customers are having a heated disagreement over the last waffle. The entire diner can hear the commotion!

events.title: Extraterrestrial Customer
events.description: A being from another world has materialized in booth 7. They're pointing at the menu with a tentacle, clearly fascinated by waffles.
resolution_options: Serve them the special (scattered, smothered, covered)
Act like this is completely normal

events.title: The Griddle Monk
events.description: A wandering monk has assumed the lotus position directly on the griddle. They're warm but unbothered. Profound peace radiates from them.
resolution_options: Join them in meditation (gain wisdom bonus)

events.title: Famous Person Spotted
events.description: Is that...? No way. Someone who looks suspiciously like a major celebrity is eating hash browns in the corner, trying not to be recognized.

events.title: Temporal Anomaly Detected
events.description: A confused person in strange clothing insists it's the year 1955. They're asking why the jukebox plays 'modern music' and won't accept credit cards.

events.title: Secret Admirer
events.description: Someone has left a heart-shaped waffle and a love note for one of the staff. The entire crew is trying to figure out who sent it.

events.title: The Regular Who Isn't There
events.description: Every staff member swears they just took an order from the regular in booth 3, but when they check, it's empty. The coffee cup is still warm.

events.title: Undercover Food Critic
events.description: Word on the street: there's a renowned food critic in the house RIGHT NOW, and they're taking notes. Everyone's on edge.

events.title: The Jukebox Has Opinions
events.description: The jukebox started playing songs that perfectly match everyone's emotions. Nobody touched it. It's making people uncomfortable.

events.title: Health Inspector Surprise Visit
events.description: The health inspector just walked in with a clipboard and a very serious expression. Everything needs to be spotless. NOW.

events.title: The Prophetic Dishwasher
events.description: The usually quiet dishwasher has started speaking in riddles and prophecies. Some of them are... disturbingly accurate.

events.title: Waffle House Wedding Proposal
events.description: Someone is about to propose to their partner at table 5. It's actually really sweet. Everyone's trying not to stare.
resolution_options: Bring out a special waffle with candles
Get the whole diner to cheer

events.title: Cryptid in the Parking Lot
events.description: Multiple customers are reporting a 'large, hairy creature' in the parking lot. It might be Bigfoot. It might be a really hairy guy in a coat. Who knows?

events.title: Mysterious Power Outage
events.description: The lights just went out. Emergency lights kicked in. The griddle is still hot though. The show must go on.

events.title: Philosophy at 2 AM
events.description: Two customers at the counter have started an intense philosophical debate about the meaning of hash browns. Others are joining in. It's getting deep.

events.title: Talent Scout in the House
events.description: A talent scout claims they're looking for the next big server personality for a reality show. They're watching everyone work.

events.title: The Toy That Won't Leave
events.description: A child left a stuffed animal last week. It keeps appearing in different locations no matter how many times staff put it in lost and found. It's watching.
resolution_options: Give it a seat and a menu

events.title: Surprise Flash Mob
events.description: A group of customers suddenly burst into coordinated dance. Did they plan this? Is this a TikTok thing? Should you join?
resolution_options: Keep serving hash browns like nothing's happening

events.title: Archaeological Discovery
events.description: While mopping under booth 2, someone found what appears to be an ancient coin or artifact. It's glowing faintly. This is definitely not normal.
resolution_options: Keep it as a good luck charm
Put it back (don't anger ancient spirits)

events.title: Storm Refugees
events.description: A massive storm just hit and the Waffle House is suddenly packed with people seeking shelter. You're now a beacon of hope in the darkness. Classic.
resolution_options: This is what Waffle House was made for
